q0998: Backup frequency is driven by RPO (how much data you can lose). RTO drives how fast you recover.

q1000: Remove unused servers, ports and public info = attack surface reduction.
q1001: Collects logs from everything, correlates them, raises alerts = SIEM.
q1002: Malware quietly collecting data and sending it to bad-reputation IPs = spyware.
q1003: Getting access you were never verified for (authorized before authenticated) = privilege escalation.
q1004: Disgruntled employee turning malicious = insider threat.
q1005: OSINT research without touching the target = passive reconnaissance.
q1006: Putting a dollar figure on a loss = quantitative risk analysis.
q1007: Malware living only in RAM (fileless) = memory injection.
q1008: From inside a VM to the hypervisor = VM escape.
q1009: Mass unsolicited messages to many users = phishing (BEC is narrow and targeted).

q1012: Look-alike domain registered to mimic a real site = typosquatting.

q1018: Operational mirror, ready immediately = hot site.
